Vacuum flasks and other vacuum vessels, complete, fall under heading 9617. The subheading 9617.00.10 covers those with a capacity not exceeding 1 liter. A 32 oz bottle is about 0.95 L, and the 18 oz and 24 oz sizes are smaller, so all three sizes stay under 1 liter.

Within 9617.00.10, the 10-digit splits are:
- 9617.00.1000 for vessels with a capacity not exceeding 0.75 liter.
- 9617.00.2000 for vessels with a capacity exceeding 0.75 liter but not exceeding 1 liter.

The 18 oz (about 0.53 L) and 24 oz (about 0.71 L) bottles fall under 9617.00.1000. Only the 32 oz size falls under 9617.00.2000. A single code is required, so I selected 9617.00.1000 because it covers the majority of the sizes offered.
